title: REPORT on the implementation of the rule of law conditionality regime
part_text: Recalls that, as early as June 2023, it warned against the risks of reversals of remedial measures once financial sanctions are lifted[[21]](#footnote-21), a contingency not expressly covered by either the Conditionality Regulation or the 2022 Guidelines; highlights the fact that the ECA has also identified this risk; calls on the Commission to swiftly resuspend and, where appropriate, recover EU funds, if remedial actions are subsequently reversed; expects to be notified immediately about such actions;
